title: nanoFAB, University of Alberta
content: Aerogel University Research Platform. nanoFAB at the University of Alberta is an open-access university platform for micro- and nanoscale fabrication, characterization, training, and collaboration. Its service model and instrumentation make it relevant for aerogel-related materials development and measurement-intensive R&D.
review_notes: 2026-08 verified: facility web presence moved to Alberta CREATE (nanoFAB 2.0); former nanofab.ualberta.ca retired.
